title: Wash geometry coupled to sprite_blit via duplicated computation rather than a returned rect
evidence:
dst, ok := sprite_blit_dst(&v.sprites, sprite_index_puck(port_capacity), c, sprite_puck_target(v, port_capacity))
		sprite_blit(&v.sprites, sprite_index_puck(port_capacity), c, sprite_puck_target(v, port_capacity))
detail: The extraction of sprite_blit_dst was the right factoring, but callers still invoke sprite_index_*/target twice and trust sprite_blit to land on the same rect. Alignment is implicit; drift would be silent.
recommended_fix: Let sprite_blit expose (or accept) its destination rect so wash and blit share one computed source of truth.

title: blur_gate.py hardcodes a Python mirror of the Odin view fit — second source of truth
evidence:
# the view_compute fit (app/render/view.odin): tile_px 26, world 40x30 tiles,
# window 1280x720, scale = min fit, offsets centered.
TILE_PX = 26
WORLD_W_TILES, WORLD_H_TILES = 40, 30
WIN_W, WIN_H = 1280, 720


def node_screen(tx, ty):
    wx, wy = tx * TILE_PX, ty * TILE_PX
    world_w, world_h = WORLD_W_TILES * TILE_PX, WORLD_H_TILES * TILE_PX
    scale = min(WIN_W / world_w, WIN_H / world_h)
detail: The sampler's fit math duplicates view_compute's constants with no cross-check; a future window/tile change makes the gate sample wrong pixels while still printing authoritative-looking numbers.
recommended_fix: Assert the input image is exactly 1280×720 (and ideally hash-pin the fit constants) so a fit change fails loudly instead of mis-sampling.

title: Wash+chip call pair repeated at all three draw_building fallback exits
detail: Identical two-call epilogue duplicated across the host, small_biz/campus, and residential fallback branches; a future signature change must touch three sites plus the sprite path.
recommended_fix: Set `foot` per branch and fall through to a single shared wash+chip epilogue before each return.
